---
name: Skill proposal
about: Propose a new portable agent skill or a substantial skill change
title: "[Skill] "
labels: skill-proposal
---

## User and problem

Who needs this workflow, and what repeatedly goes wrong without it?

## Trigger phrases

What would a user say that should load this skill?

## Existing skills checked

Name the closest skills and explain why this behavior does not belong in one of
them.

## Portable method

Describe the provider-neutral workflow. Separate any required client adapter.

## Acceptance evidence

What source, installed, live, continuity, or capability evidence will prove the
skill works?

## Public boundary

Confirm that examples and configuration contain no personal, client, or
organization-specific material.
